title: Battle of Sialkot (1761)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Sialkot (1761)", at revision 1370274305, opens: "The Battle of Sialkot was fought between Durrani Empire and Sukerchakia Misl of Dal Khalsa in 1761." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q21244905, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1761 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
